Only the brawniest of Bokoblins can manage its immense weight.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 24 |durability = 18 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Dragonbone Boko Club}} Dragonbone Boko Clubs are often found being used by [[Black Bokoblin|Black]] and [[Silver Bokoblin]]s. In [[Master Mode]], they are also used by [[Golden Bokoblin]]s. They belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created by [[Bokoblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Being reinforced with fossilized bones has increased the amount of damage that Dragonbone Boko Clubs can deal. They are commonly found in Bokoblin [[Monster Stronghold]]s on [[Hyrule Ridge]] and near the [[Necluda Sea]]. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn when the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Being made of wood, Dragonbone Boko Clubs will burn and eventually disintegrate if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. This tactic is often used by enemy Bokoblins, who will set their Clubs on Fire to deal additional damage to [[Link]]. They also do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]], unlike metal [[Weapon]]s, and they will float if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]].
